title: Canonical adic evaluation and completed reindexing maps
statement: Use completed integral coefficient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], the recorded completed/rational/common-field tensor, pullback and permitted internal Hom [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and sectionwise module inverse image [def-sf-proetale-sectionwise-module-inverse-image]. Use the partial closed data (additive tensor-Hom transposition on exactly the permitted pairs), its evaluation and the permitted-pair pullback functor of [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces]. The common-field closed datum is the unique one whose inverse transpose on every common finite coefficient-field representative is rational inverse transposition conjugated by the prescribed stage tensor/Hom maps. Define the Hom comparison of that pullback on permitted pairs as the transpose of inverse tensor comparison followed by pulled-back evaluation. For a scheme isomorphism and a finite coefficient field, define completed ring transport as the limit lift of all finite coefficient projections followed by their constant-normalized coefficient maps. Define completed module inverse image using that ring transport, and its derived functor by exact termwise derivation. Define comparison to tower pullback as inverse image of the completion unit followed by the inverse resolution-normalized total-limit comparison and inverse Roos-model identification; on complete constructible inputs take the isomorphism of this very map. These are the existing canonical definitions, with their specified normalizations, not new assertions that compatibility laws hold.
